title: Elon Musk Considers Merging Tesla and SpaceX
excerpt: Special committees have been established at both Tesla and SpaceX to evaluate a potential mega-merger between the two companies.
body_html:
Elon Musk has confirmed that he is evaluating a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX. According to the announcement, special committees have been established within both organizations to review the feasibility of combining the companies into a single entity.

Further details regarding the timeline or the specific structure of the potential mega-merger have not yet been disclosed.
